affected_modules: MVP3 process protocol and backend link
existing SM1/P6 decision and replay ports
repair_map.canonical_owners: Native NetworkedGameplayService owns players and replay; P6 owns identity/admission ledger; SM1 owns transfer state and epoch. Gateway adapters own no canonical state.
root_causes: The new process payload schema did not satisfy the existing ProtocolFrame planet_simulator namespace contract.
BackendLink.call collided with native Object.call and therefore failed under warnings-as-errors.
HMAC was calculated over a native double before the first transport JSON round-trip; tick_delta_seconds then shortened by one decimal digit and invalidated an intact reply.
The first gateway lookup read the native player one wrapper level too high.
Replay fingerprints were local to a per-authority adapter, so the receiving route could not reject a conflicting payload before the shared P6 ledger returned ALREADY_APPLIED.
During a second transfer the gateway sent the prior completed transfer beside the new post-commit epoch; the read model correctly rejected that inconsistent pair.
canonical_fixes: Use the accepted ProtocolFrame namespace and sign the stabilized JSON round-trip representation.
Use an explicit rpc_call method and preserve fail-closed verification diagnostics.
Require a signed native owner receipt before P6 completion and share immutable operation fingerprints across both gateway routes.
Publish a completed transfer view only while its target epoch equals the current coordinator epoch.
repair_map.not_symptom_patch: The process gate uses three OS processes, real ENet frames, the accepted P6 admission/closure route, existing SM1 transfer state and the native Service. It checks causal state and signed receipts rather than accepting labels or process exit alone.
